label: A account_changes wallets, 30d
sql: SELECT block_date, affected_account_id, update_reason, affected_account_nonstaked_balance FROM `bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us.account_changes` WHERE block_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND affected_account_id IN ('fefundsadmin.sputnik-dao.near','1csfundsadmin.sputnik-dao.near','buybacks.multisignature.near')

label: A account_changes wallets, since 2025-05-10
sql: SELECT block_date, affected_account_id, update_reason, affected_account_nonstaked_balance FROM `bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us.account_changes` WHERE block_date >= DATE '2025-05-10' AND affected_account_id IN ('fefundsadmin.sputnik-dao.near','1csfundsadmin.sputnik-dao.near','buybacks.multisignature.near')

label: B ft_balances_daily wallets since 2025-05-10
sql: SELECT epoch_date, account_id, liquid FROM `bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us.ft_balances_daily` WHERE epoch_date >= DATE '2025-05-10' AND account_id IN ('fefundsadmin.sputnik-dao.near','1csfundsadmin.sputnik-dao.near','buybacks.multisignature.near') ORDER BY account_id, epoch_date
